proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H a b
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb : b ∈ {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, x = b * h} := ⟨1, H.one_mem, by simp⟩
    rw [← h] at hb
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := hb
    rw [he]
    simpa using hc
  · intro hab
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(a⁻¹ * b)⁻¹ * c, H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem hab) hc, by group⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(a⁻¹ * b) * c, H.mul_mem hab hc, by group⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (a b : G), {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, x = a * h} = {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, x = b * h} ↔ a⁻¹ * b ∈ H
